ucs.title: [LLM] BlackCat (ALPHV/Noberus) Rust encryptor invocation via --access-token CLI flags
ucs.description: Hunts for execution of the BlackCat/ALPHV/Noberus Rust-based ransomware binary, which requires a unique combination of command-line flags (--access-token + payload modifiers like --paths, --no-prop, --target=esxi) to decrypt its embedded configuration and detonate. The flag surface is documented by Microsoft, Mandiant, and CrowdStrike as ALPHV-specific.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmd values(Processes.process_path) as image values(Processes.user) as user values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process="*--access-token*" OR Processes.process="*--access_token*") AND (Processes.process="*--paths*" OR Processes.process="*--no-prop*" OR Processes.process="*--no-net*" OR Processes.process="*--target=esxi*" OR Processes.process="*--no-vm-kill*" OR Processes.process="*--bypass*" OR Processes.process="*--child*" OR Processes.process="*--no-prop-servers*" OR Processes.process="*--ui*") by host Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name Processes.user Processes.process_id | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rex field=cmd "--access[-_]token[=\s]+(?<token>[A-Fa-f0-9]{20,})" | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// BlackCat / ALPHV / Noberus encryptor — unique --access-token + payload-modifier flag combination
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("--access-token", "--access_token")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("--paths", "--no-prop", "--no-net", "--target=esxi", "--no-vm-kill", "--bypass", "--child", "--ui", "--drag-and-drop", "--safeboot")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"           // exclude machine accounts
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| extend Token = extract(@"--access[-_]token[=\s]+([A-Fa-f0-9]{20,})", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath,
          ProcessCommandLine, Token,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// BlackCat / ALPHV — Sentinel SecurityEvent 4688 variant of the encryptor flag detection
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where CommandLine has_any ("--access-token", "--access_token")
| where CommandLine has_any ("--paths", "--no-prop", "--no-net", "--target=esxi", "--no-vm-kill", "--bypass", "--child", "--ui", "--drag-and-drop", "--safeboot")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE")
| extend Token = extract(@"--access[-_]token[=\s]+([A-Fa-f0-9]{20,})", 1, CommandLine)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName,
          CommandLine, ParentProcessName, Token
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: BlackCat (ALPHV / Noberus) Ransomware Encryptor CLI Flags
id: 5fa2e1c8-3d71-4b1f-9c6e-a2d4e8f7b3a1
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of the BlackCat / ALPHV / Noberus Rust-based encryptor using its characteristic --access-token plus payload-modifier flag combination (e.g. --paths, --no-prop, --target=esxi).
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2022/06/13/the-many-lives-of-blackcat-ransomware/
  - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/alphv-blackcat-ransomware
  - https://www.crowdstrike.com/blog/blackcat-ransomware-as-a-service/
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/10
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1486
  - actor.alphv
  - actor.blackcat
  - actor.noberus
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_token:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '--access-token'
      - '--access_token'
  selection_modifier:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '--paths'
      - '--no-prop'
      - '--no-net'
      - '--target=esxi'
      - '--no-vm-kill'
      - '--bypass'
      - '--child'
      - '--ui'
      - '--drag-and-drop'
      - '--safeboot'
  condition: selection_token and selection_modifier
falsepositives:
  - None known — this flag combination is unique to ALPHV/BlackCat
level: critical
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.security OR windows.sysmon) (@EventID:4688 OR @EventID:1) (@CommandLine:*--access-token* OR @CommandLine:*--access_token* OR @CommandLine:*--ACCESS-TOKEN*) (@CommandLine:*--paths* OR @CommandLine:*--no-prop* OR @CommandLine:*--no-net* OR @CommandLine:*--target=esxi* OR @CommandLine:*--no-vm-kill* OR @CommandLine:*--bypass* OR @CommandLine:*--child* OR @CommandLine:*--ui* OR @CommandLine:*--safeboot*) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| regex("--access[-_]token", field=CommandLine)
| regex("--(paths|no-prop|no-net|target=esxi|no-vm-kill|bypass|child|ui|drag-and-drop|safeboot)", field=CommandLine)
| UserName!=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, SHA256HashData, ParentBaseFileName], function=count())
| count > 0
ucs.rationale: The Rust ALPHV/BlackCat encryptor mandates an --access-token argument (the decryption key for its embedded JSON config) and ships unique payload-control flags such as --paths, --no-prop-servers, --no-net, --target=esxi, --no-vm-kill, and --drag-and-drop. Microsoft (DEV-0237), Mandiant, and CrowdStrike (SCATTERED SPIDER affiliate writeups) have all documented this exact CLI surface as the ALPHV sig

ucs.title: [LLM] BlackCat (ALPHV) affiliate BYOVD — POORTRY / aswArPot / Burnt-Cigar driver load to kill EDR
ucs.description: Hunts for ALPHV affiliates dropping signed-but-vulnerable kernel drivers (POORTRY, aswArPot.sys, ktgn.sys, BURNTCIGAR) into staging directories, registering them as kernel-mode services, and using them to terminate security products before encryption. This BYOVD chain was the defining ALPHV pre-encryption tradecraft in 2022-2024 (Microsoft, Sophos, Trend Micro reporting).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmd values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name="sc.exe" AND Processes.process="*create*" AND Processes.process="*type=*kernel*" AND (Processes.process="*\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\Users\\Public\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\AppData\\*") by host Processes.user Processes.process_id | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | join type=inner host [| tstats summariesonly=t count from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name="poortry.sys" OR Filesystem.file_name="aswArPot.sys" OR Filesystem.file_name="ktgn.sys" OR Filesystem.file_name="burntcigar.sys" OR Filesystem.file_name="aukill.sys" OR Filesystem.file_name="hellokitty.sys" OR Filesystem.file_name="viragt64.sys") OR (Filesystem.file_name="*.sys" AND (Filesystem.file_path="*\\Temp\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Users\\Public\\*")) by host Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`] | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// BlackCat / ALPHV BYOVD — vulnerable-driver staged + kernel service registered + EDR killed within 1h
let Lookback = 7d;
let KnownDrivers = dynamic(["poortry.sys","aswarpot.sys","ktgn.sys","burntcigar.sys","aukill.sys","hellokitty.sys","viragt64.sys","rentdrv2.sys","procexp152.sys","truesight.sys","gmer64.sys"]);
let DrvDrops =
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where FileName endswith ".sys"
    | where tolower(FileName) in (KnownDrivers)
         or FolderPath has_any (@"C:\Windows\Temp\", @"C:\ProgramData\", @"C:\Users\Public\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\AppData\Roaming\")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("TrustedInstaller.exe","msiexec.exe","MoUsoCoreWorker.exe","SetupHost.exe","WindowsUpdateBox.exe","drvinst.exe")
    | project DropTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, DrvFile = FileName, DrvPath = FolderPath,
              DropProc = InitiatingProcessFileName, DropCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              DropUser = InitiatingProcessAccountName, DrvSHA256 = SHA256;
let KernelSvc =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where FileName =~ "sc.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has "create"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("type= kernel","type=kernel","type= k","type=k")
    | project SvcTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, SvcCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              SvcUser = AccountName, SvcParent = InitiatingProcessFileName;
let EdrKill =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where (FileName =~ "taskkill.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("MsMpEng","SentinelAgent","CSFalconService","CSAgent","CarbonBlack","cb.exe","CylanceSvc","elastic-agent","xagt","Sophos","TaniumClient"))
         or (FileName =~ "net.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "stop" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("WinDefend","Sense","SentinelAgent","CSFalconService","CarbonBlack","cbdefense","CylanceSvc","Tanium"))
    | project KillTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, KillCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
DrvDrops
| join kind=inner KernelSvc on DeviceId
| where SvcTime between (DropTime .. DropTime + 1h)
| join kind=leftouter EdrKill on DeviceId
| where isnull(KillTime) or KillTime between (DropTime .. DropTime + 1h)
| project DropTime, SvcTime, KillTime, DeviceName, DrvFile, DrvPath, DrvSHA256,
          DropProc, DropCmd, SvcCmd, SvcUser, KillCmd
| order by DropTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// BlackCat / ALPHV BYOVD chain — Sentinel ASIM file + process correlation
let Lookback = 7d;
let KnownDrivers = dynamic(["poortry.sys","aswarpot.sys","ktgn.sys","burntcigar.sys","aukill.sys","hellokitty.sys","viragt64.sys","rentdrv2.sys","procexp152.sys","truesight.sys","gmer64.sys"]);
let DrvDrops =
    ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where EventType == "FileCreated"
    | where TargetFileName endswith ".sys"
    | where tolower(TargetFileName) in (KnownDrivers)
         or TargetFilePath has_any (@"\Windows\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\AppData\Roaming\")
    | where ActingProcessName !endswith @"\TrustedInstaller.exe"
         and ActingProcessName !endswith @"\msiexec.exe"
    | project DropTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, DrvFile = TargetFileName,
              DrvPath = TargetFilePath, DropProc = ActingProcessName,
              DropCmd = ActingProcessCommandLine, DrvSHA256 = TargetFileSHA256;
let KernelSvc =
    SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith @"\sc.exe"
    | where CommandLine has "create"
    | where CommandLine has_any ("type= kernel","type=kernel","type= k","type=k")
    | project SvcTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SvcCmd = CommandLine,
              SvcUser = SubjectUserName, SvcParent = ParentProcessName;
DrvDrops
| join kind=inner (KernelSvc | project-rename DvcHostname = Computer) on DvcHostname
| where SvcTime between (DropTime .. DropTime + 1h)
| project DropTime, SvcTime, DvcHostname, DrvFile, DrvPath, DrvSHA256,
          DropProc, DropCmd, SvcCmd, SvcUser, SvcParent
| order by DropTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.security OR windows.sysmon) (@EventID:4688 OR @EventID:1) @Image:(*\sc.exe OR *\SC.EXE OR *\Sc.exe) @CommandLine:*create* (@CommandLine:*type=*kernel* OR @CommandLine:*"type= kernel"*) (@CommandLine:*\\Temp\\* OR @CommandLine:*\\ProgramData\\* OR @CommandLine:*\\Public\\* OR @CommandLine:*\\AppData\\* OR @CommandLine:*poortry* OR @CommandLine:*aswArPot* OR @CommandLine:*aswarpot* OR @CommandLine:*ktgn* OR @CommandLine:*burntcigar* OR @CommandLine:*aukill*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten TargetFileName=/\.sys$/i
| TargetFileName=/(poortry|aswarpot|ktgn|burntcigar|aukill|hellokitty|viragt64|rentdrv2|procexp152|truesight|gmer64)\.sys/i OR regex("\\\\(Temp|ProgramData|Public|AppData)\\\\", field=TargetFileName)
| ContextImageFileName!=/(TrustedInstaller|msiexec|MoUsoCoreWorker|drvinst)\.exe$/i
| join({
    #event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\sc\.exe$/i
    | regex("create", field=CommandLine)
    | regex("type=\\s*k(ernel)?", field=CommandLine)
  }, field=aid, include=[CommandLine, ImageFileName])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, TargetFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
ucs.rationale: ALPHV affiliates uniformly chain three actions in close sequence: (1) stage a vulnerable signed driver (POORTRY abused via leaked Microsoft WHQL signing, or aswArPot.sys/BURNTCIGAR via Avast's Anti-Rootkit driver) into a writable directory, (2) register it via 'sc create … type= kernel', (3) call into its IOCTL to terminate EDR/AV processes before encryption.
